heaping_notes.subset_relationship: Multiples of ten are a SUBSET of multiples of five. The two percentages must not be presented as separate facts; report multiples of 5 with 'of which multiples of 10' nested inside.
heaping_notes.non_round_peaks: The concentrations at 12 and 13 are not round numbers and are not age heaping; they more plausibly reflect adolescent concentration or a recall anchor.
heaping_notes.floor_at_5: Reports at 5 are confounded with the left-censoring floor ('5 or younger') and should not be read as heaping either; see the pct_left_censored_at_this_age column.
heaping_notes.wording: Reported onset ages showed round-number concentration consistent with possible age heaping: 29.4% of events fell on multiples of five, including 10.7% that were multiples of ten.
